title: A Large Scale Search Dataset for Unbiased Learning to Rank

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Unbiased Learning to Rank (ULTR) algorithms (e.g., Inverse Propensity Weighting, Dual Learning Algorithm, Regression EM) on user click logs to mitigate the effect of a document's ranking position on the likelihood of a user examining and clicking it.

Providing and analyzing rich page presentation features (such as displayed abstracts, titles, and multimedia types) combined with user behavior data to study how document display layout fulfills user requirements without necessarily requiring a click.
Providing large-scale search logs and expert relevance annotations to allow for the modeling of user trust in higher-ranked search engine results over inherently relevant but lower-ranked documents.
